null_policy: Every null is an unmet prerequisite; no field is an optional success or permission to execute.
rejection_rules: Reject the PR head, test merge, pre-F0 main or old B3 baseline as a substitute for the actual protected F0 main commit.
Reject inherited Verify/summary/Release/convergence success from another head, attempt or workflow.
Reject a candidate F1 run as evidence that its F0 predecessor was already qualified.
Reject a manifest hash or candidate-authored assertion without original Actions metadata and independent original-artifact readback.
Reject first execution while any pending state or null prerequisite remains.
External issue creation or a candidate-supplied freeze object cannot turn pending baseline fields into closed evidence.
No engineering-process or launcher first execution while this prerequisite is pending, even if source editing/static compilation has separately been authorized.
implementation_order: Source/test editing and static compilation may be separately authorized before F0 main closure; no F1 launcher, engineering-process fixture or DSP execution before real D/B closure, complete final C review and external freeze.
freeze_record_cycle_boundary: This source-locked baseline records only closed predecessor evidence and the already-existing issue identity. The future approving comment ID/body hash and C are runtime/additive evidence, not prerequisites embedded back into this file.

protected_execution_base_B.null_policy: Every field is required before final C freeze; if B equals qualified D, retain explicit equality and references to D original gate evidence rather than inventing separate runs.

execution_authorized_field_semantics: Always false for this prerequisite record alone, including after its closure state becomes qualified; live source/event freeze and explicit root decision supply execution authority separately. Do not backfill a future comment ID/hash into this locked baseline.
